summary: Griffon Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the completed sale of its AMES North America business to Veritage Brands, a portfolio company of ONCAP Management Partners, on June 9, 2026. The divestiture is accounted for as discontinued operations. Specific financial terms such as price per share, total consideration, and premium were not disclosed in the excerpt. The filing includes exhibits and financial statement items related to goodwill impairment and other comprehensive income adjustments. What to watch: potential use of proceeds and impact on future operations.
